sloka: इयम् आकाश गंगा यस्याम् पुत्रम् हुताशनः ।जनयिष्यति देवानाम् सेनापतिम् अरिंदमम् ॥१-३७-७॥
transliteration: iyam ākāśa gaṁgā yasyām putram hutāśanaḥ ।janayiṣyati devānām senāpatim ariṁdamam ॥1-37-7॥

translations.english: "Ganga keeps flowing in the celestial regions. Through Ganga the Firegod will beget a son who will be capable of destroying enemies. He will become the army general of the gods".
